scope: Current complete replacement, including Lottie; simulator/emulator evidence

method.aggregation: Median of the three run means; median of within-run nearest-rank P95s
method.completion: Synchronous owned RGBA readback, not GPU submission alone
method.settle: Eight foreground seconds, then native warmup; no builds during sampling
method.managed: Actual Hermes bitmap API: Skia CPU raster vs TGFX GPU upload/render/readback
method.native: Both real GPU paths: Android GLES; Apple Metal
method.power: Process CPU time is activity only; no physical-device energy measurement
method.dependencies: Same outer opt/production flags. Imported TGFX/ThorVG retain their recorded vendor builds; not normalized compiler settings or a renderer-only microbenchmark. Android TGFX effective -Os, ThorVG optimization 3 with SIMD, no LTO.

androidRuntime.scope: Same-source opt/production/strip ARM64 runtime; AAR compressed size is not APK/download/install size

iosSimulatorRuntime.scope: ARM64 iOS simulator opt/production/strip runtime. Not device or App Store download size.

iosSizeOnlyNormalizedCopies.scope: Size-only copies with identical strip -S -x. Not a signed application, deployment artifact or device-slice estimate.

validation.iosVariability: Large across-run spread; no significance or stable-device speedup claim
